label: The packet has no envelope rule and the three new verbs disagree: activity prints an object, chat prints a bare array, and routines prints neither by name.

The precedent is the object envelope: bots status --json prints the whole StatusReport object with named keys, never a bare array, so the rule should be one object with named keys and a collection under a named key.

bots chat --json as a bare array is the one verb that breaks the precedent, and 003s chat pane reads it, so changing it later breaks the screen; change 010 REQ-006 to {messages: []} before 003s fixture is written.

No phase states the stdout/stderr split for a --json verb though the existing verb implements it: status sends rebuild progress to stderr and the document to stdout, and the new verbs state no such rule.
Two different state vocabularies ship in one packet: an items state is open/answered/expired and an activity rows state is one of the seven group ids, so one key name carries two meanings.
